function.name: exec_command
function.description: Run a shell command with bash -lc in the workspace, or in workdir when given. Standard output and error are merged. Output past about 10k tokens is cut in the middle, keeping its beginning and end.

workdir.description: Directory to run in; the workspace by default.

function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Edit files with a patch: *** Begin Patch, then *** Add File: path (lines starting with +), *** Delete File: path, or *** Update File: path (optionally *** Move to: path) followed by hunks of context lines (starting with a space), removed lines (-) and added lines (+), each hunk optionally headed by @@ and a nearby line, then *** End Patch. Paths are relative to the workspace. The patch applies whole or not at all.

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Record the plan: short steps, each pending, in_progress or completed, with exactly one in_progress while work remains.
